rationale: To close the -$11k cash deficit against 135k+ champions, this mutation expands the land ceiling from 14 to 18-20 plots between Days 8-20, giving our 10-11 hired hands the acreage needed to prevent idle wage drag and compound recurring Strawberry yields. It elevates Oracle Frontrun to Priority 3 and raises routine liquidation floors to >=1.05x base price to eliminate margin leakage, while enforcing strict shop seed phase-gates (halting Pumpkins at Day 14, Tomatoes at Day 18, Carrots at Day 25) to protect Strawberry acreage and avoid unharvested late-game crops. Finally, it explicitly synchronizes fertilizer application into routine farm dispatch and purges phantom livestock feed reserves, unlocking early bootstrap capital.
